title: BossStager scene rectangle and boss music selection

0x546d5c.name: SetRect
0x546d5c.reason: Windows rectangle construction is supplied natively.

limits: SetRect is a native platform fixture.
Physical music play and stop virtual methods are case-supplied services; music selection and lookup execute original game code.
The existing 0x42a630 readiness helper is reused through its original address; this family does not duplicate its ownership.
notes: Single-player manager+0x2c uses vtable 0x50c264: +0x10 is 0x40af90 and +0x60 is 0x46cab0, established by original 0x428c40 mode-3 allocation/publication and hash-checked vtable bytes. The latter selects BOSS music, not camera reset. 0x42a450 is thiscall RET4 returning its output pointer; both other roots are thiscall RET0 returning u32. wire-object-boss-stager must reuse CheckpointTimerRuntime readiness and MusicRuntime selection with native audio; check this family with make gate FAMILY=boss_scene_services ARGS=--record before scripts/check-native-object-connection.sh boss_stager.
